installer.welcome_thanks: Thank you for choosing us. SkyNet is made by a team of students full of enthusiasm, and having you install it means a lot to us.
installer.welcome_text: SkyNet creates a private virtual network so you can play and share with your friends, without opening router ports.
installer.feat_ports: No open ports, no router changes
installer.finish_thanks: Thank you for trusting us. If you like it, tell your friends: it's more fun with them.
installer.welcome_text2: This wizard will install version {v} on your computer. Close other programs if you need to, then press Next.
installer.welcome_update_text: You already have SkyNet {old}. It will be updated to version {v}; your saved network and settings are kept.
installer.dir_invalid: Enter a full path, for example C:\Program Files\SkyNet.
installer.opt_sub: Choose how SkyNet integrates with Windows.
installer.opt_note: SkyNet will ask for administrator permission when it opens: it is needed to create the virtual network adapter. A Windows firewall rule is also added.
installer.p_kill: Closing SkyNet if it was open…
installer.err_text: The operation could not be completed. Close SkyNet and try again.
installer.un_text: SkyNet will be removed from this computer: files, shortcuts and firewall rules.
installer.un_data: Also delete the saved network and settings
installer.cancel_text: Nothing has been installed yet. You can open it again whenever you like.

app.Configura tu nodo principal y genera las: Pick a key and share the code.
app.Inicializa una red, coordina nodos y est: Create a network and connect your people.
app.Mínimo 12 caracteres. Pulsa GENERAR para: At least 12 characters. GENERATE makes a random one. It's all that protects your network.
app.Comparte este código con los demás nodos: Share this code with the others.
app.El modo directo no necesita tocar el rou: No router changes: you swap two codes and the key goes separately. It's remembered on restart. Works if neither side has symmetric NAT (Settings → Diagnostics).
app.1. Pasa el código de acceso de arriba a: 1. Send the code above to your guest, and
app.la clave de red por otro canal: the network key through another channel
app.(ningún código la lleva y sin ella no pu: (no code carries it, and without it they can't join).
app.2. Él lo pega en «Unirse» y te devuelve: 2. They paste it in «Join» and send you back a
app.3. Pégalo aquí y pulsa ACEPTAR; los dos: 3. Paste it here and press ACCEPT. They get in within seconds.
app.Introduce las credenciales que te ha env: Paste the code and enter the key.
app.La clave la eligió el host y se comparte: The host picks it; it's shared separately from the code.
app.Pasa este código de respuesta al host (p: Send this reply code to the host. When they paste it, you connect automatically (waits up to 3 min).
Host PC only. KICK (in the table) removes a member, and you can also block them.
app.Todo viaja cifrado por la red virtual y: Everything is encrypted. Received files go to Downloads\SkyNet and never open on their own.
app.Herramientas de conectividad para redes: For when the router can't be opened.
app.Cuando alguien pulsa \"Crear red\", esa: If the host's router won't open ports, nobody can join. Enabling this on THIS PC makes it receive the connections instead. It only helps if this PC is reachable from the internet.
app.Si tu router no permite abrir el puerto: If the router won't open the port, this server is used instead of failing. Saving checks that it responds.
app.SI TU ROUTER NO DEJA ABRIR PUERTOS: IF YOUR ROUTER WON'T OPEN PORTS
app.SkyNet intenta abrir el puerto solo con: SkyNet tries UPnP and NAT-PMP. If both are off (or you're behind CGNAT) it can't be opened from here. You have three options:
app.Activar UPnP o NAT-PMP en el router (Ava: Turn on UPnP or NAT-PMP in the router (Advanced → UPnP).
app.Abrir el puerto a mano: Configuración →: Open the port manually: Settings → Diagnostics gives you the steps.
app.Usar un servidor de respaldo con puertos: Use a backup server (a VPS or someone's PC with an open router): below.
app.Con la 3, ni tú ni tus amigos tocan ning: With 3, nobody touches a router. The server only helps you find each other; data stays encrypted end to end.
app.Reconecta la red recordada al abrir SkyN: Reconnects the saved network when SkyNet opens.
app.Puedes desconectar y olvidar la red actu: Disconnect and forget the current network.
app.Te desconecta y borra la red recordada:: Disconnects and clears the saved network: it won't reconnect on its own.
app.Abrir el puerto a mano en el router (pas: Open the port manually (step by step)
app.¿No conecta, el chat no llega o va con l: Can't connect, chat not arriving or lagging? SkyNet checks your connection, firewall and members and tells you how to fix it.
app.Si algo falla, envía el registro de SkyN: If something breaks, send the log to the team. Codes, keys, your Windows username and part of the IPs are hidden first.
app.Si SkyNet se cierra con errores o de for: If SkyNet closes with errors, it sends the log by itself (max. one every 6 h).
app.En Crear, pon una clave (o pulsa GENERAR: In Create, set a key (or GENERATE) and your name, then press CREATE NETWORK.
app.Copia el código de acceso que aparece y: Copy the code and send it with the key (preferably through different channels).
app.Abre Unirse, pega el código, escribe la: In Join, paste the code, enter the key and press CONNECT.
app.En Ver Red ves quién está conectado y có: In Network you see who's connected and how (direct or relay). Click an IP to copy it.
app.Usa las IPs virtuales (25.10.x.x) en tus: Use the virtual IPs (25.10.x.x) in your games and apps, as if on the same LAN.
app.La red se recuerda y reconecta sola al a: The network is remembered and reconnects by itself. To leave: Settings → Disconnect and forget.
app.SkyNet pide permisos de administrador: e: It asks for administrator: needed for the virtual adapter.
app.En Chat puedes escribir a otro nodo y en: In Chat you can message and send files. The other person always has to accept them (saved to Downloads\SkyNet).
app.Ejecuta Configuración → Ejecutar diagnós: Run Settings → Run diagnostics and share it with whoever is helping you.
app.Pide un código nuevo: la IP del host pue: Ask for a new code: the host's IP may have changed.
app.Con CGNAT o NAT simétrico hace falta un: With CGNAT or symmetric NAT you need a backup server (Advanced tab).
app.Comprueba que el firewall o el antivirus: Check that the firewall or antivirus isn't blocking SkyNet.
app.Sin tocar el router: Crear → Crear en mo: Without touching the router: Create → Direct mode. Send the code, they send a reply code back and you paste it in ACCEPT.
app.Puedes volver a abrir esta ayuda cuando: You can reopen this help from the side menu.
app.Este tipo de archivo puede ejecutar prog: This file type can run programs. Accept it only if you trust the sender and expected it.
app.Aparecerá al crear la red: Appears when you create the network
app.Cómo aparecerás en la red: How you'll appear on the network
app.¿Enviar los errores al equipo automática: Send errors to the team automatically? The log is only sent when the app fails, without keys, codes or your Windows username. You can change it anytime in Settings.
That file isn't a valid language.
No new languages, or no connection.
app.Buzón activo: tu invitado entra solo al: Mailbox active: your guest joins on their own after pasting the code and key. No reply code needed.
app.Respuesta enviada al host automáticament: Reply sent to the host automatically. Just wait a few seconds.
